teams.heading: Teams
teams.empty: No teams yet. Start one with “New team”: the four members and the mechanic first, the name when you save.
teams.dragInstructions: Press Space to pick the character up, the arrow keys to move them and Space again to drop them on another slot. Escape cancels.
teams.dragListInstructions: Drag the grip, or with it focused use the up and down arrows to move the team one place.

plan.serverTitle: The day rotates on the server's clock and turns over at 04:00, not midnight
plan.assumeTitle: Counts characters with no target as if headed for level 90 and talents 9
plan.sourcesCountDay: {count} with a target · {domains, plural, one {# domain} other {# domains}} · {anytime} with no schedule
plan.sourcesCountAll: {count, plural, one {# build} other {# builds}} with a level target · {domains, plural, one {# domain} other {# domains}} · {anytime} with no schedule
plan.noTargetsMessage: Nobody has a target yet, so there's nothing to farm. Demand is the gap between where a character is and where they should be.
plan.fixTargetLink: Set a level or talent target on a sheet
plan.costToLevelAllPrefix: or see what it'd cost to level them all with
plan.collectionHint: Bosses, local specialties, enemy drops and Mora. No schedule: it's a matter of quantity, not which day it is. Each pile opens to show how much is missing and who's waiting on it.
plan.explainer: With no target written down, the plan assumes every character is headed for level 90 with talents at 9. Tap a name to look only at their demand; use the × to dismiss them, and their demand disappears from the total, not just from view.
plan.stopFilterTitle: Stop looking only at this character

upgrades.pendingSummary: {total} pending · {actionable} doable now · {fixes} close a goal
upgrades.movementsCount: {count, plural, one {# move} other {# moves}} · +{gain} total{more}
upgrades.chainExplainer: Applied in this order. Each move frees up a piece, and some are only possible thanks to the one before.
upgrades.empty: Nothing to do yet. The queue fills up when a team slot declares a role and that character has a build with that role —
upgrades.goalUnreachable: {prop} {actual}/{min} — nothing in your account fixes it

build.objectiveIntro: Where {name} is today, and where you want to take them.
build.costCovered: What you hold already covers this objective. Nothing left to farm for it.
build.noSwapsMessage: Nothing you own improves what's equipped. What's left is farming: check
build.roleHint: A character has one goal per role, and the role is its identity: it's what a team slot looks for, and what decides the starting thresholds and substats.
build.importHint: Level, constellation and talents come from the last import.
build.refinementNotPlannable: not forgeable — refinement is copies you draw, not work you do
build.statGoalsHint: The total you want to reach, not the per-piece split. Every change is judged against this: met, close or short. Two or three is usually enough — Furina is HP, crit rate and crit dmg; Sucrose, a thousand mastery and little else.
build.fillFromRoleTitle: Refill set, main stats, substats, weapon and thresholds with what the chosen role asks for
build.hiddenInUse: {count} in use outside the plan, hidden
